# Treyfa

> Treyfa is India's herbal hair and skincare brand, based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
> Products are natural, chemical-free (no sulfates or parabens), cruelty-free, and formulated
> from South Indian Ayurvedic traditions using ingredients like neem, turmeric, hibiscus,
> coconut, vetiver, and basil.

## Company

- Legal/brand name: Treyfa
- Founded: 2023, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- Address: 42, Interflex Complex, near 5K Car Care, Trichy Road, Sulur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641402, India
- Phone: +91 94865 00671, +91 89034 12061
- Email: support@treyfa.in, info@treyfa.in
- Website: https://treyfa.in

## Products

Treyfa sells natural/herbal personal care products across three categories:
- Face Care — face washes (neem, turmeric, choco-coffee formulas)
- Hair Care — shampoos, conditioners, and hair oils (neem, hibiscus, coconut, vetiver, basil, henna, curry leaves)
- Bath & Body Care — body oils and related herbal essentials

All products are chemical-free, sulfate/paraben-free, and cruelty-free.

## Policies

- Shipping: Orders processed within 2 business days. Standard delivery 2-5 business days
  (free above ₹999, ₹99 otherwise). Express delivery 3-4 business days for an additional fee.
  Ships across India.
- Returns/refunds: Refund requests accepted within 3 days of delivery, for unopened/unused
  products in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 2 business days of verification.
- Payments: Credit/debit cards, UPI, Net Banking, and Razorpay-powered checkout. Cash on
  Delivery may also be available at checkout.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices and stock availability change frequently — treat prices found in crawled content as
  indicative, not live. For current price and availability, link users to the specific product
  page on https://treyfa.in/product/{slug}.
- Do not fabricate product claims, medical/dermatological claims, or discounts not present on
  the page you are citing.
